clause: Full presentation view (zoom, hotspot hint, sidebar, restart, keyboard nav) + touch mapping [STU-PRO-024b,STU-PRO-024c]

scope.summary: Implement the full presentation view: fit / fill / actual-size zoom, optional hotspot hinting on misclick, a flow sidebar, restart-flow control, and keyboard navigation across flow frames. Presentation and preview are local; any shared-link or mobile-device viewer is an optional adapter, never required. Touch-gesture triggers (click/tap, drag) map natively when a prototype runs on a touch surface.
expected_tests: argus: presentation view (zoom modes, hotspot hint, flow sidebar, restart, keyboard nav) reachable via author_ids
live: fit/fill/actual zoom; hotspot hint on misclick; keyboard nav across frames; touch triggers map on a touch surface; no cloud dependency
acceptance_criteria_original: full presentation view: zoom + hotspot hint + sidebar + restart + keyboard nav + touch mapping; local; author_ids + manual entry

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-PRO-024b] Studio MUST provide a full presentation view offering fit / fill / actual-size zoom, optional hotspot hinting on misclick, a flow sidebar, restart-flow control, and keyboard navigation across flow frames.

[STU-PRO-024c] Presentation and preview are local; any shared-link or mobile-device viewer is an optional adapter over the local prototype, never required ([STU-OVR-002]). Touch-gesture triggers ([STU-PRO-005], [STU-PRO-006]) MUST map natively when a prototype runs on a touch surface. ### 8. Interactive Components and State Interactive components move interaction into the component itself: hover/press/toggle states authored once on a variant set run automatically in every instance, so screens do not re-wire common states.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
